properties.name: G0099/26 / WPDB
properties.originalText:
DRONE OPERATINOS FOR AERIAL SURVEY AND MAPING ON THE SOUTH WEST OF
WPDB (SUAI)
WITHIN RDL 1500  3100 RADIUS OF 5 NM OF SUAI VOR WITH THE CRUSING ALT
660 FT AGL. 
PILOTS ARE ADVISED TO TAKE PRECAUTIONARY DURING APCH OR DEP AND
SUBJECT TO ATC CLR OR CTC ON CTAF 127.1 MHZ OR KAYRALA INFO.

THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED ON BEHALF OF THE CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY OF
TIMOR LESTE.
